title: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+
description: The Binding of Isaac: Afterbirth+ is a randomly generated dungeon-crawling action game. Every run reshuffles rooms, enemies, bosses, and item combinations. Nintendo lists more than 600 collectible items, 13 playable characters, more than 180 enemy types, over 90 bosses, and thousands of room combinations. This store file also maps the supplier’s Chinese Repentance package as separate variants.
